name: GUI-Actor-7B-Qwen2.5-VL
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.392 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-06-01. Caveat: not a general VLM finetune - the checkpoint is Qwen2.5-VL plus an attention-based action head, and the two benchmarks are GUI grounding only (ScreenSpot-Pro/-v2). Card Table 1 is the Qwen2-VL backbone and was excluded; Table 2 is the Qwen2.5-VL backbone and carries the base row we recorded. +17.0 pp on ScreenSpot-Pro is against a base that was never trained for grounding, so the margin is task fit, not general capability.

benchmarks.name: ScreenSpot-Pro
benchmarks.config: Card Table 2 (Qwen2.5-VL backbone), column 'GUI-Actor-7B' vs column 'Qwen2.5-VL-7B' 27.6. Own-eval table from the GUI-Actor paper; grounding-only task, no generation.
